title: Communications & Programmes Intern - Placement Year
description:
Communications & Programmes Intern - Placement Year
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
Who We Are:
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
Job Description:
Location: Central London
Start Date: July 2027
You might not know HPE yet. But you’ve probably experienced the impact of our technology.
Ever streamed a film, followed a Formula 1 race, visited a major sporting event or wondered how AI is changing the world? Behind many of these experiences is technology that connects people, processes huge amounts of data and helps organisations do extraordinary things.
Big technology. Bigger opportunities to make a difference.
At HPE, we believe a great workplace is built by its people. Across the UKIMEA, our team members are creating communities, championing inclusion, supporting wellbeing and making a real difference beyond their day jobs.
Our culture isn’t just something we talk about. It’s something our people actively build.
Through our Resource Groups and Site Councils, colleagues lead initiatives that bring people together, celebrate different backgrounds and help everyone feel they belong. Our Day of Service has brought thousands of volunteering hours to charities and local communities, while our commitment to inclusion, wellbeing and development has earned recognition at the CRN Women & Diversity in Channel Awards, including the Health and Wellbeing Recognition Award and Highly Commended Best Place to Work. And you don’t need to be a senior leader to make an impact. Some of our most exciting ideas come from people just starting their careers.
Your placement. Your opportunity to make an impact.
We’re looking for a curious, creative and motivated Programmes Intern to join our UKIMEA (UK, Ireland, Middle East and Africa) Managing Director’s Office in London for a 13-month placement.
This isn’t a role where you’ll spend a year watching from the sidelines.
You’ll work alongside a team that helps shape how we communicate, engage our people and connect with some of the world’s leading organisations. One day you might be helping bring a leadership event to life, the next creating communications that reach colleagues across different countries, supporting an initiative that makes a difference in our communities, or helping develop programmes that connect our senior executives with customers.
You’ll gain exposure to different parts of the business, work with experienced leaders and have the opportunity to bring your own ideas to the table.
We don’t expect you to know everything when you arrive. What matters is your curiosity, willingness to learn and enthusiasm to get involved.
If you’re looking for a placement where you can develop your skills, build meaningful relationships and finish the year knowing you’ve made a real contribution, we’d love to hear from you.
What you’ll need:
Potential interns must be in their 2nd year of a four-year degree which requires (or has an option for) 3rd year to be a one year's industrial placement, and are expected to achieve a minimum of a 2:1 grade
Ideally from degree courses focused on communications/business management/graphic design/film production preferred.
You must be eligible to work in the UK and be available to commence the placement at the beginning of July 2027 for 13 months.
Experience or knowledge of video production and/ the use of Adobe software including InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects and Premier Pro Ability to use the Microsoft Office package to a high standard (particularly Excel & PowerPoint).
What we’d prefer you bring:
You'll be able to use your own initiative and self-motivation to work independently
You will have good time management and organizational skills while being structured in your approach
You'll be adaptable in handling new and evolving requirements
Show Creativity in approaching projects
Exceptional written, visual and oral communication skills
Accuracy and attention to detail
What you'll do:
End to end production of internal videos
Experience in the use of various Adobe software to create clear and branded communications
Creation of a company magazine, posters, slide decks and newsletters to promote events projects, company strategy and initiatives to a wide audience of employees
An opportunity to develop both professional and technical skills
Exposure to senior leadership and collaboration widely across the organization
Reviewing, editing and creating various communications content
Maintaining fresh and accurate content for key intranet sites
Tracking and overseeing budgets
Coordinating end to end events
Strategic planning for events in place and in development
Using an analytical approach, provide valuable feedback, thoughts and opinions
Accessibility
HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here .
Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.
What We Can Offer You:
Health & Wellbeing
We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
Personal & Professional Development
We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
Unconditional Inclusion
We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.
Let's Stay Connected:
Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

We also never request personal information such as back account details, Social Security numbers, or national IDs via social media or chat applications.
All legitimate job opportunities will come through official company channels, and candidates are responsible for verifying the credentials of any third party claiming to represent the company. Any reliance on fraudulent communication is at the individual’s own risk, and HPE disclaims legal liability for any resulting damages. If you suspect recruitment fraud, do not share personal information or make any payments and report the incident to your local authorities immediately.
